name: html-runtime-form-real-action-preserved
description: Preserves data-entry forms with real submit endpoints as runtime HTML while keeping readable metadata for downstream materialization.

source_reference.notes: A non-placeholder action is runtime submission metadata even when the form has no scripts or inline events.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.

input.content: <main><form class="contact-form" action="/contact" method="post"><label for="email">Email</label><input id="email" name="email" type="email" required><button type="submit">Send</button></form></main>
